summary: Southwest City is a city in McDonald County, Missouri, located in the southwestern corner of the state. It had a population of 937 at the 2010 census, when it was classed as a town. It belongs to the Fayetteville–Springdale–Rogers, AR-MO Metropolitan Statistical Area.
one_line: Southwest City is a small city in McDonald County, in the southwestern corner of Missouri, with 937 residents in 2010.
